results.title: India News Live Updates: Orange alerts limited as Gujarat rain likely to ease from Saturday
results.description: India News Live Updates: Even as Gujarat continued to battle severe flooding after three days of relentless rain, the India Meteorological Department (IMD) forecast a slight improvement from Saturday, limiting orange alerts to Sabarkantha and Aravalli as the heaviest downpours are expected to gradually shift and ease in the coming days.
